title: Move charge across more voltage
hook: Change potential-difference magnitude and predict electric-work magnitude.
misconception: electric-work magnitude stays fixed when potential-difference magnitude doubles.
objective: Apply work magnitude = abs(qΔV) to compare electric-work magnitude when potential-difference magnitude changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a fixed charge magnitude, work magnitude = abs(qΔV). When potential-difference magnitude doubles, electric-work magnitude becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model work magnitude = abs(qΔV); scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a fixed charge magnitude, with a nonzero initial result. If potential-difference magnitude triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on electric-work magnitude?
recall.why: Apply work magnitude = abs(qΔV) under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
